features.qr_body: Guests scan the QR on their table, browse your menu and order from their phone — no app to install. Orders land with the right table automatically.
features.kds_body: A live kitchen screen shows every ticket as it arrives, with status updates back to the floor, recipes and stock at hand.
features.waiter_body: Waiters take orders, answer table requests and collect bills; captains get a floor overview to assign tables and spot delayed orders.
features.booking_body: Accept advance table reservations and hall/event bookings with packages, decoration, cake and parking add-ons.
features.wallet_body: Customer wallets, loyalty points, coupons and promotions that bring guests back.
features.payments_body: Take UPI, card and net-banking payments online through Razorpay, alongside cash at the counter — with refunds tracked in one place.
features.branch_body: Run several locations from one account, each with its own tables, menu items, staff and QR codes.
features.inventory_body: Track stock and recipes, see which dishes are affected by low stock, and keep a customer list for repeat business.
features.analytics_body: Dashboards for sales, orders, payments and staff performance, with exports for your accountant.
features.kiosk_body: Put a tablet at the counter and let walk-in guests order and pay by themselves.
features.page_body: Every restaurant gets a shareable page with its menu, hours, takeaway and booking — at {{host}}.
features.lang_body: The customer app is available in English, Hindi and Marathi.
features.title: Everything your restaurant runs on
features.subtitle: From the guest’s first scan to the end-of-day report, every part of service stays in sync.

how.s1_body: Tell us your restaurant name, city and pick your web address. Takes about two minutes, no card needed.
how.s2_body: Your 14-day free trial starts right away — you’re signed in and live as soon as you register.
how.s3_body: Sign in to the admin panel, add your menu, tables and staff accounts.
how.s4_body: Download a QR code for each table, stick them up, and start taking orders.
how.title: Live in four steps

faq.q1: Do my guests need to install an app?
faq.a1: No. Guests scan the QR code on their table and order in their phone’s browser. Your staff use BestoDine in the browser too — on a phone, tablet or computer.
faq.a2: Right away. Register your restaurant and your 14-day free trial begins instantly — you’re signed in and can set up your menu and tables in minutes.
faq.a3: Yes — every new restaurant gets 14 days free with all Gold plan features, and no card is needed. Your data is kept safe when the trial ends, and you can choose a plan any time to continue. Not sure which plan fits? Request a demo and we’ll help you choose.
faq.a4: Yes. BestoDine integrates with Razorpay for UPI, cards and net-banking, and your waiters can still settle cash bills at the table or counter.
faq.q5: I have more than one outlet. Is that supported?
faq.a5: Yes — plans with multi-branch support let you manage several locations from one account, each with its own tables, staff and QR codes.
faq.q6: What is my restaurant’s web address?
faq.a6: You choose it during registration, for example {{host}}. It becomes your public page with your menu, takeaway and booking options.
faq.title: Questions, answered

evening.title: One evening, start to finish
evening.intro: Seven moments in a normal evening, and what each person sees. Guest, kitchen, waiter, owner: one system, no retyping.
evening.s1_title: A guest finds your page and books a table
evening.s1_body: Your restaurant has its own web page with the menu, hours and a booking button. The guest books from the phone; the table is held and nobody wrote anything in a register.
evening.s1_alt: A restaurant’s public BestoDine page on a phone, with menu, hours and a booking button
evening.s2_title: The table scans the QR, orders and pays from the phone
evening.s2_body: No app, no waiter waved down. The order lands against the right table with no KOT to rewrite, and the guest can pay by UPI before they leave.
evening.s2_ph1: The guest sees the menu in their own language, adds items to a cart and sends the order.
evening.s2_ph2: They can pay now by UPI or ask for the bill at the end.
evening.s3_body: Every ticket appears on the kitchen screen the moment it is placed, with a timer per item. The floor sees the status change, so nobody walks back to ask.
evening.s3_alt: The BestoDine kitchen display with live tickets and timers
evening.s4_title: The bill, UPI, and a tip that goes to staff
evening.s4_body: The GST bill is ready when the guest is. They pay by UPI, card or cash and can add a voluntary tip; tips are pooled by shift and paid out to your staff.
evening.s4_ph1: The guest sees the itemised bill with GST and taps to pay by UPI, card or at the counter.
evening.s4_ph2: A tip, if they wish, goes to the staff pool for that shift.
evening.s5_title: A waiter answers a table request
evening.s5_body: A table asks for water from the phone; the waiter’s app shows which table and who is on it. The captain sees every table by status and spots the one that has waited too long.
evening.s5_alt: The BestoDine waiter app showing tables by status on a phone
evening.s6_title: A party-hall booking, with the advance taken
evening.s6_body: A family books the hall for Saturday: package, decoration, cake, parking. The advance is collected and the balance is due on the day, all inside the same system as the tables.
evening.s6_alt: The BestoDine bookings dashboard with hall and table bookings
evening.s7_title: The owner reads the day’s numbers on the phone
evening.s7_body: Sales, orders, payments by method, what sold and what ran low, in one view before bed. Exports for the accountant are a tap away.
evening.s7_alt: The BestoDine owner dashboard with the day’s sales and orders

stopped.title: What you stopped doing
stopped.intro: Five tools the owner kept before. One system now, and nothing to copy from one to the other.

only.title: Three things only BestoDine does
only.tips_body: Guests can add a voluntary tip when they pay, on the phone or at the counter. Tips are pooled by shift and paid out to the staff who worked it, with a record you can show. It is the legal substitute for the mandatory service charge that is no longer allowed.
only.tips_why: Why it matters: staff earn more and stay longer, and you stay on the right side of the rules.
only.banquet_title: Banquet and advance booking inside the POS
only.banquet_body: Halls, packages and add-ons live next to your tables, not in a separate diary. Take the deposit when the booking is made and the balance on the day. The kitchen and the floor see the event the same way they see a table.
only.banquet_why: Why it matters: the hall is often the most profitable room in the building, and it deserves the same system.
only.ops_body: Tick how your restaurant actually works: no waiters, pay-first at the counter, self-service, token numbers instead of tables. The whole app follows, from the guest’s phone to the kitchen screen. Change it any evening without calling anyone.
only.ops_why: Why it matters: the product adapts to your service, not the other way round.

answers.title: Straight answers
answers.a1: Short drops are fine: printing catches up when the connection returns. In a long outage, fall back to paper slips and enter them afterwards. Full offline billing is not available yet.
answers.a2: No. 0% on your own orders, always. The only charge on online payments is the payment gateway’s own fee.
answers.q3: Can I get Zomato/Swiggy orders in it?
answers.a3: Coming soon, it is on the roadmap. Today those orders stay in the aggregator apps.
answers.a4: Coming soon. Today you get full Excel/CSV exports of sales, payments and GST for your accountant.
answers.q5: Can I leave and take my data?
answers.a5: Yes. One-click export of your menu, orders, customers and bookings. Monthly plans cancel any time.
answers.a6: English, Hindi and Marathi for guests today.
